opinions.feedback: Cases G-006 and G-007 reference 'given image' which is missing or ambiguous, making them untestable. Cases G-004 and G-005 test View menu items for Classic and Modern themes, but the requirements R-180 and R-181 only state that the items shall be available without detailing how to verify them against an external reference, though they are testable as direct menu presence checks. However, G-006 and G-007 are insufficiently specified due to the missing image reference.
confirmed_blockers: Case G-006 depends on a 'given image' which is missing, making the expected behavior untestable.
Case G-007 depends on a 'given image' which is missing, making the expected behavior untestable.

qualitative.rationale: Candidate round-2-candidate-1 successfully covers all 7 requirements (R-175 through R-181), correcting the missing test coverage for R-176 and R-177 that was present in the accepted state. Both round-2-candidate-1 and round-2-candidate-3 are structurally valid and improve the objective requirement coverage, but round-2-candidate-1 provides cleaner test case descriptions without redundant phrasing.
